motionContract.finalState: Selected storyboard step persists until next/reset
motionContract.interrupt: Next cancels prior transition; reset returns to first step; pause/resume preserves animation
motionContract.reducedMotion: Instant step change; runtime preference commits target and cancels active motion
motionContract.sequenceBudget: 200ms out + 360ms in; inspect traced tasks above 50ms and active resources; no universal FPS claim

reviewRubric.blockers: Critical task, focus, reflow, legibility or lifecycle failures cannot be compensated by score

limits: Author verification is not independent visual review
